invalid.sanitizer_scope: accepted native and runtime-diagnostic families only

new_owner.evidence: ABI descriptor plus allocation mutation control

optimized_metadata.evidence: exact before/after metadata plus removal mutant

payload_copy.evidence: native counter, C scan, assembly, mutations

competing_explanations: Descriptor passing looks zero-copy only because ownership ancestry is absent from HIR/MIR.
Inlining can erase reborrow boundaries or their end order.
A child descriptor may silently outlive its parent even when native execution happens to succeed.
Conditional control flow may terminate child reborrows on only one path.
preregistration.falsifier: Any lifetime annotation, new owner, allocation, free, payload copy, retain/release, escaping child, child ending after parent, owner access before the full chain ends, lost optimized metadata, branch imbalance, sanitizer violation, valid<256, invalid<192, or full-suite failure prevents PASS.
preregistration.hypothesis: A BytesView borrowed parameter can be compositionally reborrowed through direct synchronous call chains of depth 1-3 without lifetime syntax, ownership duplication, allocation, payload copy, reference counting, or escape beyond the originating chain.
preregistration.minimal_change: Permit immutable BytesView parameter forwarding only across non-recursive direct synchronous calls to depth three and add versioned reborrow evidence extensions.
preregistration.required_evidence: surface/HIR/MIR/native differential corpus, exact negative diagnostics, no-inline ABI per level, optimized assembly, structural allocation/copy/RC counters, ASan/UBSan/LSan, one full suite, frozen hashes.
preregistration.stop_condition: Stop on confirmed safety defect; otherwise choose exactly one preregistered status after one Decision Run.

scope.supported: immutable BytesView compositional reborrow through direct synchronous depth-1-to-3 chains

self_skeptical_audit.name: SELF_SKEPTICAL_AUDIT
threats: identity_erasure
Require root, parent, child, depth, SymbolId, RevisionId, and source mapping in versioned HIR.
metadata_only_proof
Cross-check HIR, unoptimized MIR, optimized MIR, generated C, native counters, and assembly.
inlining_erasure
Ownership-bearing calls may remain uninlined; optimized MIR must retain every ancestry and end marker.
hidden_descriptor_owner
ABI descriptor contains only const pointer and length and no live/ownership/refcount fields.
hidden_copy
Inspect every no-inline helper and optimized assembly; inject a deliberate memcpy falsification control.
conditional_imbalance
Reject borrowed-parameter forwarding present on only one branch of an if.
recursion_hides_unbounded_depth
Reject cycles in the borrowed-call graph before lowering.
depth_misclassification
Propagate call-graph depth from root slice calls and reject depth greater than three.
same_call_owner_overlap
Reject one direct call that borrows a view and transfers its root owner.
sanitizer_overclaim
Only accepted native and runtime-diagnostic executions count as sanitizer-tested.
duplicate_generated_cases
Publish independent family/template/seed distributions and content hashes.
common_mode_oracle
Use independent Python references plus surface HIR, two MIR levels, and native binaries.
old_benchmark_reuse
Run no timing benchmark and do not reuse the prior Bytes timing result as reborrow proof.
post_hoc_status
Freeze statuses and every gate before implementation.
